title: Figure 32: Design of an automated cell culture system for NASA space applications
description: Rendering of three stacked clear micromachined acrylic plates with fluidic channels, wells and bolt holes against a red-to-white backdrop, above a yellow-and-red CAD wireframe of the assembled layered device. Caption reads "Figure 32. Design of an Automated Cell Culture System for NASA Space Applications Incorporating Microfluidics and Integrated Optical Components (Towe et. al.)" Text notes the system was laid out in CAD and machined from acrylic.
